claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.spell_slot
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The magic-item activation spends the wielder's own spell slot instead of an item use counter or charge pool.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.class_list_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item does not grant one named spell; it opens a filtered choice over Wizard-list spells the wielder does not know, bounded by castable level and material-cost ceiling.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can't have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.inherit_granted_spell_casting_time
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On success, the item casts the chosen spell using that spell's own casting time, so the activation does not have one fixed action cost expressible in the current non-spell activation header.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time"
